correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the entrance makes the M-1 middle letters a uniform surjection onto n-1 labels. A zero-truncated Poisson distribution conditioned on its total yields n^alpha K/m ->1 for its singleton count using a span-one local CLT and concentration. Singleton locations are a uniform K-subset, whose falling factorial moments converge on bounded rescaled intervals to independent Poisson intensities. Multiple-occurrence labels whose final appearances expire in t=O(n^alpha) have expected count O(n^(alpha-1)), and possible redraw rescue has O(t/n) probability. These controls couple first loss to first singleton clock and prove exp(-x) survival. Stationary complete mass/entrance flux gives the stated exact finite mean and mean asymptotic separately from weak convergence. Valid only 0<alpha<1 and stationary entrance Palm law. Independent finite Palm examples agree with the exact mean and survival sandwich.
